北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京风力 5级，体感 -5℃。注意保暖，多喝水哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing feels like -5℃ with strong winds. Keep warm and stay hydrated!

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪小雨，体感 5℃。出门记得带伞，注意防寒哦！
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Light rain in Cixi, feels like 5℃. Don't forget your umbrella and stay warm!

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海有雾，能见度低。请注意交通安全，小心慢行！
上海.ai_briefing_en: Fog in Shanghai, low visibility. Please drive safely and take it slow!

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州阳光正好，气温 19℃。出门记得带好雨具，湿度较大哦！
广州.ai_briefing_en: Sunny in Guangzhou, 19℃. Enjoy the warmth, but bring an umbrella due to high humidity!
广州.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳气温 20℃，体感 22℃，很舒适。多喝水，防晒也不能忘哦！
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is lovely at 20℃, feels like 22℃. Stay hydrated and remember sun protection!

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州小雨，体感 3℃。出门带伞，注意添衣保暖，别着凉！
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Light rain in Hangzhou, feels like 3℃. Take an umbrella and dress warmly!

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京有雾，能见度低。体感 1℃，出门注意保暖和交通安全！
南京.ai_briefing_en: Fog in Nanjing, low visibility. Feels like 1℃, so keep warm and drive safely!

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都阴天，气温 8℃。体感略凉，早晚温差大，注意添衣哦！
成都.ai_briefing_en: Overcast in Chengdu, 8℃. It feels cool, so dress appropriately for temperature changes!

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉有雾，体感 4℃。请注意出行安全，多穿件衣服暖和些！
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Fog in Wuhan, feels like 4℃. Be careful when traveling, and dress warmly!

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安多云，体感 3℃，空气干燥。注意保暖，记得多喝水滋润！
西安.ai_briefing_en: Cloudy in Xi'an, feels like 3℃ and dry. Keep warm and stay hydrated!

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆阴天，体感 8℃。湿度较大，出门别忘添衣，小心着凉！
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Overcast in Chongqing, feels like 8℃. High humidity, so dress warmly and avoid catching a cold!

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨有雾，体感 -22℃！请务必全副武装，注意防寒防冻！
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Fog in Harbin, feels like -22℃! Bundle up completely and protect yourself from frostbite!
哈尔滨.alert: 🥶 红色极寒警报：体感低至 -22℃

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳多云，体感 -17℃。寒冷刺骨，请一定多穿厚衣服保暖！
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Cloudy in Shenyang, feels like -17℃. It's biting cold, so please layer up warmly!
沈阳.alert: ❄️ 橙色寒冷提示：体感低至 -17℃

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明多云，体感 9℃。早晚温差大，记得添衣，小心着凉哦！
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Cloudy in Kunming, feels like 9℃. Large day-night temperature difference, dress accordingly!

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门多云，气温 18℃，风力 4级。海边风大，注意防风保暖哦！
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Cloudy in Xiamen, 18℃ with 4-level winds. It's windy by the sea, so stay warm!

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛风力 4级，体感 -2℃。出门注意防风保暖，多喝热水！
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao feels like -2℃ with 4-level winds. Keep warm, protect from wind, and drink hot water!

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连多云，体感 -4℃。气温较低，请务必注意保暖，别冻着！
大连.ai_briefing_en: Cloudy in Dalian, feels like -4℃. It's cold, so please dress very warmly!
